Alpha 1.24.0 (the Fire journey)

  • Find the Magma Golems: Fire hunts now mark their actual enemy sectors instead of the region center. The Chronicle hunt points to the level-75-or-higher Magma Golem grounds before the Wraith sector, not to the Molten Core entrance.
  • Ore and hazards: Cinderheart Ore guidance starts in the first Fire sector and explains chance drops and physical pickup. All Fire search instructions warn that a waypoint is not a safe path: watch the lava and hazard warnings.
  • A forged Kiln Span: Lower iron arch webs, edge flanges, bolts, cross ties and visible stone supports replace the smooth hoops. The crown fits the normal camera; ground collisions and walking clearance stay unchanged.
  • The road is not the repair: Hessa’s ledger, the cold-ash investigation and command-anchor fight, manual Ilyra turn-ins, level-70 Molten admission and the separate Ember Crown repair raid remain intact. No XP, drop-rate, quest-count or gear changes.
  • Continued open-alpha work: Human pacing, supported-device performance and final modern-art approval remain open. This release does not open closed beta. Full prior patch history is retained below.

Alpha 1.23.0 (the Water journey)

  • Find the right hunting grounds: Water hunt waypoints now mark the actual Troll and Aqua Golem sectors instead of sending every hunt to the Abyssal Well. Instructions show required enemy levels and distinguish search areas from guaranteed spawns. The actual dungeon entrance and the Earth-based Construct chapter keep their correct destinations.
  • Pearls and preparation: Moon-Tide Pearl guidance starts in the first snowfield and explains chance drops and physical pickup. Both investigations, manual Ilyra turn-ins, dedicated bag icons, level-60 Abyssal admission and the separate Tidestar repair raid are preserved. No XP, drop-rate, quest-count or gear changes.
  • A carved Tide Rib: Low stone ribs, visible supports, flood-height marks and natural surface detail replace smooth blue tubes. The crown fits the normal camera, with existing ground collisions and walking clearance unchanged.
  • Recognizable wrecks: The Stranded Flotilla now has tapered hulls, curved surviving planks and missing timber sections. Its walking aisle stays clear; the wrecks are scenery, not walkable decks or safe zones.
  • Continued open-alpha work: Human pacing, actual-phone group play and final modern-art approval remain open. This release does not open closed beta. Full prior patch history is retained below.

Alpha 1.22.0 (clearer roads through Earth)

  • Hunt where the enemies are: Earth quest waypoints no longer send you to the center of Lanternhold. The opening and first Skeleton hunt point beyond the east gate; later hunts show the appropriate eastern or western search sector and required enemy level. These are search areas, not guaranteed live spawns.
  • Memory Seed guidance: The map explains that Seeds are chance drops and you must pick up the quest item. Completed objectives still send you to Ilyra for manual turn-in. The Construct hunt leading into Water correctly stays in Earth.
  • A better First Grove Arch: A beveled stone vault, keystone, worn pier courses and tapered branching roots replace the square lintel and blunt tubes. Fieldstone and bark have distinct surface detail; the arch crown fits the normal gameplay view. Walking clearance and collisions are preserved.
  • Your journey stays intact: Both Earth investigations, collection and kill counts, earned rewards, level-30 Verdant entry and the later defended crystal-repair raid remain unchanged. No XP, drop-rate or gear changes. Human pacing and final modern-art work remain open; this release does not open closed beta. Full prior patch history is retained below.

Alpha 1.21.0 (a clearer picture of the journey)

  • Optional playtest timer: In Help, expand “Optional playtest timer · local only” and choose Start. Label exploring, fighting, recovering, grouping, getting lost or idle time, and mark outside help such as gifts or carries. Recording is off by default.
  • Honest timing: Hidden pages, disconnected time, input inactivity and suspended gaps are distinguished from active labels. The summary records starting/latest levels and a first observed level-30 crossing. It does not measure time with the page closed or prove a fresh character’s full journey.
  • You control sharing: Stop and review, then optionally append the summary to your existing report draft. Nothing is submitted automatically. No names, chat, raw inputs, inventory or coordinates are recorded by the timer; a report you choose to submit follows ordinary account and retention rules.
  • Bounded and temporary: Sessions stop at eight hours. Clear, changing character or closing the page removes the local session; copies explicitly added to report drafts are separate. Busy or oversized drafts are never overwritten.
  • Evidence before balance changes: Actual first-hour and level-30 pacing remain for player testing against the 2–3-hour target. There are no XP, drop, quest-reward or character changes based on these timer tests. Full prior patch history is retained below.

Alpha 1.20.0 (an integrated open-alpha foundation)

  • Help without clipped controls: Help now keeps its header and Close button visible while the contents scroll, including on short screens. Existing touch-first journey guidance and keyboard controls remain available.
  • Clear alpha expectations: Open Help’s “Open alpha · Known limits & reporting” section for performance, story-playtest and support guidance. Character art, equipment fit and world quality remain in development; this milestone does not open closed beta or claim final graphics.
  • Accurate report context: Bug reports use the same bounded realm geography as the atlas. Coordinates outside the overworld no longer imply an unrelated elemental realm. Instance type stays primary; private instance IDs are never included.
  • A connected foundation: The physical resonance portal, populated elemental sites, optional lore, atlas directions, party preparation and private admin report queue are retained from the preceding milestones. This integration preserves manual quest claims, personal entry gates, saved discoveries and dungeon recovery.
  • Unchanged access and progression: Public alpha remains open, with no wipe, reward adjustment, wager change or payment integration. Final actor-model integration, visual refinement and human pacing/device feedback remain open work. Full prior patch history is retained below.

Alpha 1.19.0 (reports in reach and safer operations)

  • In-game report review: Administrators can open Administration → Player reports, filter Open / Resolved / All reports, and inspect each report’s JSON. Ten-report pages keep the view manageable on desktop and phone-sized layouts. Viewing a report does not resolve it or punish a player.
  • Private, verified access: Every report read rechecks the server’s durable administrator role and requires an audit entry. Report text is displayed as text, never executable HTML, and is not copied into activity history. Disconnects and lost access clear the private results.
  • Open alpha continues: Closed beta waits until the game is nearly complete. Existing accounts and characters will retain access and progress; new beta players will be invited. We plan for up to 100 beta players, subject to capacity validation—not a promise of 100 simultaneous sessions today. Support stays in the in-game report tool.
  • Safer recovery tooling: The operator-only Mongo restore helper requires an exact archive and explicit data-loss confirmation, refuses active or ambiguous game-server state, and limits restoration to Eidolon. It does not stop production services or restore data automatically.
  • Preserved progress: No character wipe, access restriction, reward change, payment integration or beta opening accompanies this release. Modern art and the deferred actor-model pilot remain in progress. Full prior patch history is retained below.

Alpha 1.18.0 (worn surfaces and clearer silhouettes)

  • Fitted equipment: Rounded torso and shoulder transitions replace broad faceted chest surfaces. Silk skirts have shallow folds and fitted edging; the leather cap no longer covers the Rogue’s eyes at the viewing angle. All four classes keep their existing equipment anchors, animations and item stats.
  • Material character: Shared generated cloth, leather, metal and timber surfaces add restrained grain, roughness and relief to equipment. Cloth trim no longer reflects like metal; rarity accents, sockets and cosmetic identities remain intact.
  • Weathered places: Water, Fire and Air sites gain softly worn ground and low scattered debris outside their walking paths. These decorations grant no rewards and add no blocking floor or collision; nearby hazard warnings remain clear.
  • Atlas and minimap agreement: Dark Realm witness courts now appear on the minimap with the same place glyph and filter as the atlas. Other instances and pending layouts do not inherit those markers.
  • Choose your graphics setting: Settings explains High, Medium, Low and the phone shadow policy. Populated-world and equipment comparisons cover both qualities; desktop phone-sized tests are not real-phone performance certification.
  • Scope: This is an early visual integration pass, not final modern-art or closed-beta approval. Actor-model integration and owner art review remain open. Existing saves, manual quest claims, Gold/EP rules and dungeon recovery are unchanged. Full prior patch history is retained below.

Alpha 1.17.0 (companions and the unmeasured sky)

  • Prepare together: the Dungeon Guide now shows advice for your selected dungeon and difficulty, your listed party and readiness, and direct routes to Party controls or activity-specific recruitment. Empty listings offer useful next steps. No automatic listing, invitation or run launch; all server entry gates remain.
  • Eight places in Air: observatory and weatherworks surrounds, the Tempest Spire muster, Horizon Orrery, courier and weatherkeeper camps, and two optional lore readings. New trails and atlas destinations share real positions; camps remain combat territory, not safe zones.
  • A quieter skyward ground: wind-scoured slate replaces the repeated glowing floor grid, with registered surface relief and roughness at both quality levels. New scenery keeps approaches clear and ordinary enemy spawn counts unchanged.
  • Inhabited Dark Realm streets: four meeting courts frame the existing witnesses and records. Ten worn streets and matching atlas routes connect the district circuit, witness approaches and Nexus threshold records. These are not replacement quest givers or new dungeon entrances.
  • Progress preserved: manual quest claims, rewards, level gates, party authority, latest-boss checkpoints and the 15-minute saved dungeon logout rule are unchanged. This is a population first pass, not final graphics or closed-beta certification; real-phone party and campaign pacing feedback remains with playtesting.
  • Full prior patch history: every earlier major and corrective release remains below.

Alpha 1.16.0 (tides, cinders and the way back)

  • Sixteen places across Water and Fire: Discover tide gauges, stranded boat ribs, sailcloth refuge, communal kilns, a workers’ court, cold furnaces and new landmarks. Existing story investigations and dungeon approaches receive distinct surroundings without changing their objectives or entry requirements.
  • Roads that match the map: Sixteen physical trails and branches connect these places, with detours around existing hazards and dungeon buildings. Atlas and minimap destinations use the same anchors; scenery clearings preserve sightlines. These routes and camps remain combat territory, not safe zones.
  • Four optional stories: Read the tidekeepers’ soundings, rescuers’ names, communal firing register and broken counterseal with ordinary interaction, E or mobile USE. Learn how care became control without receiving automatic quest credit, rewards or fabricated discovery ticks.
  • Quieter ground, clearer warnings: Water terrain now reads as frost-dusted rock; Fire terrain as cooled volcanic ground. Generated surface relief and roughness replace bright repeating ground cracks, leaving actual hazards distinct. High and Low retain matching physical patterns and collisions.
  • A usable way back: Failed session recovery returns to a visible login screen, clears the password and retires the old connection. Late socket/load callbacks cannot displace a newer session. Optional browser storage failures no longer prevent HUD construction or in-session settings changes. Login now includes connection and account-help guidance.
  • Preserved progress: Scenery blocks ordinary enemy spawns and unsafe administrator landings using shared geometry. Existing encounter counts, saved quests, rewards, combat balance, Gold/EP separation, dungeon checkpoints and the 15-minute logout rule remain unchanged. This is the Water/Fire population and account-continuity milestone, not final art or completed beta readiness. Earlier patch notes remain below.

Alpha 1.15.0 (roads, refuge and remembered promises)

  • A more inhabited Lanternhold: A communal well and menders’ yard add gathering spaces, work surfaces, resting benches and quietly working residents. These are scenery, not duplicate vendors; healing and Well Rested still work throughout the safe zone.
  • Reasons to explore Earth: Eight distinct locations dress the keeper’s abandoned home, crystal-root scar, Bastion approach, First Grove arch, pilgrim camp, foresters’ yard, bellkeeper’s cairn and oath stone. Connected physical trails also appear on the atlas. Solid scenery keeps clear approaches, and random enemy spawns avoid its footprints.
  • Stories beside the road: Inspect two optional readings with E or ordinary interaction/mobile USE to learn about shelter, broken trust and the grove’s promises. These readings are optional lore, not quests or reward sources, and do not pretend to be saved discoveries. Their windows close safely when you leave, die or change areas.
  • A map of real places: Places & lore destinations share world positions with the atlas and minimap, distinguish combat territory from town recovery, and guide Bastion gatherings outside the entrance. Existing story discovery visibility remains tied to your actual quest progress.
  • A clearer beginning: Class cards explain primary stats. Starting Your Journey covers Ilyra, manual quest claims, equipment, skill training, town recovery and exploration; phone guidance appears before the desktop keyboard reference.
  • Preserved progress: No changes to earned quests, reward amounts, combat balance, Gold/EP rules or the dungeon logout rule. This is the Lanternhold/Earth population milestone, not the completed world or final graphics overhaul; other realms follow next. Full prior patch history remains below.
